title: Counter-Free Higher-Dimensional Automata for First-Order Interval-Pomset Languages

comparators.scope: 67 fixed explicit contracts: all nonexempt numbered statements, actual recognizing functor, effective finite tables, uniform and interface-specific stability, and genuine eight-cell/residual/deletion-profile Appendix.

comparators.rejection_detail: Verification.illegalSurvival is outside the permitted axioms

main_results.scope: A finite aperiodic recognizing functor with arbitrary object map, together with downward closure and bounded width, yields a finite counter-free HDA recognizing exactly the same language.
A finite-table realization with bijective cell-array decoding and explicit face restrictions.
The same constructed HDA stabilizes for every n>=2r+h at interface size r, including n>=h when r=0, without an internal-width<=r hypothesis.
The new realization implication from aperiodic recognizability to counter-free HDA recognizability; the other external characterization directions are not proved here.

main_results.scope: The original eight-cell HDA and its completion recognize the same language; the Appendix also establishes exponent-three counter-freeness, residual classification and deletion-profile calculations.
